# Ulcer Index

*Depth and duration of drawdowns from the N-bar high.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Ulcer Index** under **Oscillators**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Length | int | `14` |
| Source | source | `"close"` |
| Color | color | `"#2962FF"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/ulcer.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Ulcer Index", shortTitle: "Ulcer", overlay: false, precision: 2 });
const length = input.int("Length", 14, { min: 1 });
const src = input.source("Source", "close");
const dd = ta.calc([src, ta.highest(src, length)], (x, h) => (100 * (x - h)) / h);
plot(ta.calc([ta.sma(ta.calc([dd], (d) => d * d), length)], (v) => math.sqrt(v)), { title: "Ulcer Index", color: input.color("Color", "#2962FF", { group: "Style" }) });
```
